title: Written on the Wall II Conjecture 198a
statement: Every nontrivial finite connected simple graph G satisfying b(G)≤2+ecc_avg(G), where b(G) is the largest induced-bipartite order, has a Hamiltonian path.

counterexample.description: A finite connected simple graph satisfying the induced-bipartite and average-eccentricity premise but having no Hamiltonian path.
